stops.name: Homes & neighbors
stops.text: A street for every neighbor. Visit the residential neighborhood.

stops.name: Scrap depot
stops.text: Rescued metal. Someone has already filed it under miscellaneous.

stops.name: Timber depot
stops.text: Locally sourced. The source was a badly assembled shelf.

stops.name: Supply depot
stops.text: The essentials. In a box marked non-essential.

stops.name: Workshop
stops.text: Your workshop. The desk is temporary. The paperwork is structural.

stops.name: Café tasting counter
stops.text: An outside tasting counter. Offer one harvested radish; three tastings earn a teapot. The paperwork is on a four-hour schedule.

stops.name: Housing Registry entrance
stops.text: An earned home. Knock once; the paperwork stays outside.

stops.name: Housing Registry
stops.text: Claim a plot, upgrade a house and arrange its furnishings in shared practice. Your browser-only workshop stays saved separately.

stops.name: Square shade tree · sketch study
stops.text: Look at the spreading shape of its crown. The tree has declined to submit an organizational chart.

stops.name: Pale-barked tree · sketch study
stops.text: Look closely at the light-colored trunk and its dark little marks. This is bark, not a barcode.

stops.name: Corner fruit tree · sketch study
stops.text: The round shapes in the leaves are fruit. Harvesting and orchards are a later system; looking is free.

stops.name: Marlow · Town clerk
stops.text: Talk to Marlow.

stops.name: Jun · Grounds caretaker
stops.text: Talk to Jun.

stops.name: Pip · Town courier
stops.text: Talk to Pip.

stops.name: Inkwood trail
stops.text: The first restored trail. Access follows the bridge inspection, not optimistic calendar math.

stops.name: Bridge committee
stops.text: A future shared project: everyone contributes, everyone gets a new place to explore. Today the committee is only inspecting the concept of a bridge.

stops.name: Your rented allotment
stops.text: Three beds. No house or workshop slot required. The committee has approved having roots.

stops.name: Garden display registry
stops.text: Chosen public markers and the town welcome bed. Private garden stock stays private.

stops.name: Field clippings
stops.text: Gather two replenishing clippings and make a marker by hand. No workshop materials.

stops.name: Forked stake
stops.text: An urgent matter of almost-straight stakes. Inspect the usable end.

stops.name: Marked stake
stops.text: This stripe has been approved for lining things up.

stops.name: Nella · pine workshop & noticeboard
stops.text: A free hand-saw lesson, practical hampers and a noticeboard with notably few notices.

stops.name: Crooked pine deadfall
stops.text: Prepare fallen pine with your bound saw. All three points share one personal renewable supply.

stops.name: Forked pine deadfall
stops.text: Two trunks. One supply entitlement. The tree has declined to form a subsidiary.

stops.name: Sheltered pine deadfall
stops.text: Fallen branches, not a license to demolish the forest. Your supply is personal.

stops.name: Notched stake
stops.text: A crosspiece goes here. Probably. Inspect it to be sure.
